rationale: The desktop service exposes a stable application-owned screenshots directory. Laravel expresses the equivalent storage boundary as a named private local filesystem disk rooted at storage_path('app/screenshots'), avoiding a desktop-specific path-service wrapper while preserving a real reusable runtime contract.

runtime_behavior.probe: create/read/delete through the named screenshots disk

acceptance: canonical operation provenance is pinned to AIMW-PLAT-83994BBD03
the screenshots disk is a private local Laravel filesystem contract
the fixed screenshots root is storage/app/screenshots under the application data root
the screenshots root is not tenant-, user-, or caller-selected
the screenshots root is not exposed through Laravel's public storage link
runtime can create, read, locate, and remove a deterministic probe through Storage::disk('screenshots')
